Gets a list of all versions for a runbook in a compartment

params.name: compartmentId
params.description:
The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.
Empty only if the resource OCID query param is not specified.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose lifecycleState matches the given lifecycleState.

params.name: runbookId
params.description: A filter to return only schedule definitions whose associated runbookId matches the given runbookId.

params.name: id
params.description: A filter to return runbook versions whose identifier matches the given identifier.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from the `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.

params.name: name
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire name given.

info.name: Gets a list of all Runbooks in a compartment

params.name: compartmentId
params.description:
The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.
Empty only if the resource OCID query param is not specified.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose lifecycleState matches the given lifecycleState.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire display name given.

params.name: id
params.description:
Unique identifier or OCID for listing a single Runbook by id.
Either compartmentId or id must be provided.

params.name: type
params.description: A filter to return runbooks whose type matches the given type.

params.name: platform
params.description: A filter to return runbooks whose platform matches the given platform.

params.name: operation
params.description: A filter to return runbooks whose operation matches the given lifecycle operation.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from the `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.
